title: Shamans' accounts of little men out of a big light (Passport to Magonia)

tellings.quote: say by the way the shaman also told me 50 years ago they were little men who came out of a big light

plain: A researcher and writer named Jacques Vallee, author of a book called Passport to Magonia that compares old folklore with modern UFO reports, tells of a shaman, a traditional spiritual healer, from the Pacific or Siberia region. Vallee says the shaman told him that, fifty years before, little men had come out of a big light. He tells it because, if such accounts are real, the beings in today's UFO stories would have been showing up in traditional cultures for a long time.
